description: This file defines the TasksViewModel class, which manages task data and actions for a task organizer app, including initialization, adding, updating, completing, deleting, and restoring tasks.

classes.name: TasksViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that exposes task list data and provides methods to manipulate tasks for the UI.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Initializes the task list with default tasks if the repository is empty.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with the given title, description, and due date.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task with new title, description, and due date.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Marks a task as completed or not.

methods.name: restoreTask
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted task, used for undo actions.

methods.name: getTaskById
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID asynchronously.
